description: React component for managing and displaying a list of categories with add, edit, and context menu functionalities, integrated with Redux state management and drag-and-drop features.

methods.name: _setCategoryEdit
methods.description: Dispatches action to set category editing state with given id and temporary name.

methods.name: _updateCategory
methods.description: Dispatches action to update a category.

methods.name: _addCategory
methods.description: Dispatches action to add a new category.

methods.name: onAddCategory
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new category, opening the category list and setting temporary category state.

methods.name: handleCategoryMenuClick
methods.description: Handles right-click or menu click events on categories, managing context menu positioning and selection.

methods.name: handleCategoryRightClick
methods.description: Prevents default context menu and triggers custom context menu handling.

methods.name: onSubmitUpdateCategory
methods.description: Handles submission of category updates, dispatching update if valid.

methods.name: onSubmitNewCategory
methods.description: Handles submission of new category, dispatching add if valid.
